# Get File Details

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves a detail about a file.

## Syntax

~~~~text
fileDetail(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, property: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
fileDetail(input: ShortcutInput, property: File Extension)
~~~~
